text: Reviewer accepted the Sync rebuild. They requested CachedStore.sys.mjs capitalization and a top-level comment; the author applied both. Reviewer asked to await CardDAV population; author rejected because slow or failed remote fetch should not block syncing other items. Reviewer proposed changing an SMTP error message to outgoing; author kept SMTP because only SMTP was supported in that code. Accepted final diff.
